Géza engineers end-to-end **Business Intelligence, backend, and marketing automations** (using n8n, REST APIs, webhooks, and databases) — automating lead capture, instant email/Telegram alerts, CRM sync, invoicing workflows, campaign follow-ups, and operational reporting.

Géza develops **full-stack dynamic websites from scratch** (databases, smart forms, automated email acknowledgements, campaigns, and submission workflows) and also **customizes or modernizes existing websites** — just like the live production client site [www.ablakszigeteles.hu](https://www.ablakszigeteles.hu).

Géza builds **private personal AI assistants** tailored to business owners and busy professionals — automating daily briefings, inbox triage, personal knowledge Q&A, and routine reminders so you can reclaim hours every week and protect your work-life balance.

Every engagement starts with a free discovery chat and is scoped pragmatically for SMB budgets — whether you want a quick embedded AI bot/workflow in days or a full-stack platform.
